description.narrative: Regional Humanitarian Fund for Eastern and Southern Africa (ESA HF) - Mozambique Envelope - The Mozambique envelope of the ESA HF is a Country Based Pool Fund aimed at providing quick emergency multisector support to communities highly affected by the dual impact of conflict in the north and climate crises countrywide. The Fund will target people in need of life-saving assistance, especially with regards to Food Security & livelihoods, Emergency Shelter and NFI, WASH, Education, Health & Nutrition and Protection. Funding from the envelope is channelled through best-placed actors, primarily local and national organizations, for humanitarian response in the hardest-to-reach areas. Eligible implementing agencies include National NGOs (NNGOs), INGOs, Red Cross/Red Crescent national societies and UN agencies.
